==Location==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Wilderness of Bahdza}}

==Dialogue==
:''"I have only my own success to blame, you know. No one can make a firmer, more comfortable bed than I. Not in [[Vabbi]]. Not in all of [[Elona]].
